gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve all dynamic webhooks associated with my app to ensure they are configured correctly.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of webhooks with their details, including the ID, URL, and events they are subscribed to.

gold.user: As an application administrator, I need to register new dynamic webhooks for my application to receive event notifications.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a payload with the webhook details and return a success message along with the newly created webhook ID.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to delete a specific webhook that is no longer needed to keep the system clean.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the webhook and return a success status.

gold.user: As a support engineer, I need to check for any failed webhooks to troubleshoot issues with event delivery.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of failed webhooks with details on the failure reason and timestamps.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to refresh the webhooks to ensure they are up-to-date with the latest configurations.
gold.ideal: The API should refresh the webhooks and return a success message indicating that the refresh was completed.
